title: Junior Hicks' files on Uinta Basin UFO sightings since 1950
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Junior Hicks' files on Uinta Basin UFO sightings since 1950, about 1950- at Uinta Basin, Utah, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And Junior Hicks had detailed files going back to 1950 documenting hundreds of UFO sightings

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, talks about a local man named Junior Hicks. Fugal says Hicks kept detailed files going back to 1950 that recorded hundreds of UFO sightings in the Uinta Basin, the region of Utah around the ranch, work also linked to a book called The Utah UFO Display. If true, it would mean the area has a long, documented history of sightings.
